Leaving home and going alone to an unfamiliar place, everything feels new. On a Sunday afternoon, on a rare day off, I met a new friend. She’s from Indonesia too. To support our families, we decided to come here and work hard. The reason, of course, is to support a family of several people. I work hard every day, relying on my own hands. Video chatting with you won’t let you see my wounds. One day, when I’ve earned enough money, I’ll go back and build a big house. If I can put my children through school, I’ll be satisfied. I hope they study hard, become useful people, do what they like, and go see the Statue of Liberty. All right, good boy. Go call Grandpa and Grandma over to listen. That’s right. No one bullies me here. You don’t need to be afraid. I eat my fill at every meal, so don’t worry. Look, have I gotten thinner?
